messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from today's design review. Uploaded tinyframes for the batch vectors preview + rerank export flow: https://figma.redwood/vec-mini. Asking for a final pass on mobile toolbar behavior, CSV header mapping copy, and a11y microcopy.

Eliot Brooks: Skimmed. Two immediate notes: on mobile the kebab hides Reorder which users hit a lot. Options: 1) stacked toolbar (reorder + export visible, others in overflow) or 2) condensed icon row. I prefer stacked for touch targets.

Nina Shah: +1 stacked. Also accessibility: the count chip needs 4.5:1 contrast and keyboard focus. Suggest making it a focusable element with `aria-live` updates off of selection changes.

Carlos Mendez: For screen readers, make the list use `role=list`/`listitem` and roving tabindex. Announce selection changes via a polite live region: "3 vectors selected". When rerank slider changes and scores update, announce "Relevance scores updated" so exports aren't surprising.

Maya Chen: Good call on the rerank announcement. UX copy Q: CTA should show counts or not? Options: `Export` + counter chip vs `Export 3 vectors` direct label. Thoughts?

Eliot Brooks: Telemetry wants a stable label. If we inject counts into the CTA text, send normalized event (export_vectors.click with count metadata). UI-wise I like `Export` + visible counter next to it (keeps label stable).

Nina Shah: For accessibility keep an sr-only element that reads full text: `Export 3 vectors`. So visual label stays Export but SR users hear full context. Also ensure `aria-disabled` when count is zero.

Carlos Mendez: CSV header mapping: change placeholder from `Auto-detect` to `Auto-detected header: text`. Add inline `Edit` so people can override. Also show a 3-row preview in the modal to reduce surprises.

Maya Chen: Good. Also for large exports (>=1000 rows) we should surface an async note: "This export will be processed in the background. We'll email you when it's ready." Disable the confirm CTA while scheduling.

Eliot Brooks: Mobile detail: when many items are selected the toolbar should switch to compact stacked mode (smaller padding but preserved tappable area). Avoid moving Delete into overflow; keep primary destructive actions visible to reduce hunting.

Nina Shah: Keyboard flow recap: Tab to list, arrows to move focus (roving tabindex), Space toggles selection, Esc clears selection, Shift+Tab goes to toolbar. In the export modal, trap focus and land on the primary confirm.

Carlos Mendez: VoiceOver caveat: if we append to the live region without clearing it first VoiceOver can repeat old + new text. Use the clear-and-write pattern for the selection count live region.

a11y-bot: Checklist: 1) `role=list` + `listitem` pattern implemented; 2) roving tabindex example included; 3) polite live region for selection and rerank updates; 4) sr-only label for export with count; 5) focus visible for chips and rows; 6) export modal focus trap + descriptive aria-labels.

Maya Chen: Action items: @Eliot mock stacked toolbar frames for mobile and a compact spacing spec; @Nina draft sr-only text and export modal copy; @Carlos add aria-live code snippet and CSV preview sample; I'll consolidate and update frames by EOD. Ping me for quick sync if blocked. :sparkles:
